correctness.rationale: The Beta posterior, the ratio mA/B<1 at the first-success state, constant mass of each next-success-and-final-event, and the exact two-stage payoff identity are proved directly. Bounded delta yields a positive limiting Riemann-sum gain; Beta/Gamma asymptotics yield the explicit positive global lower bound. Seven exact-rational cases independently check the finite identities. Neither enumeration nor a failed test is used to infer infinite behavior.

value.rationale: The theorem gives a uniform all-proper-Beta-prior structural obstruction to a natural locally optimal policy, not an arbitrary numerical slice or routine specialization. It provides explicit strict counterexamples at unbounded horizons, a feasible two-stage mechanism, a nonvanishing conditional gap, and a sharp stated constant for the lower-bound construction. It does not overclaim a globally optimal regret coefficient.
